posts.title: Exemplo: como este blog é feito
posts.excerpt: Post de exemplo. Um post é escrito no estúdio e vira uma página estática deste site.
posts.html:
Post de exemplo, escrito para testar o blog.

De onde vem um post

Um post é escrito e revisado no estúdio. Quando é publicado, o site é reconstruído e o post vira uma página estática.

O que o build faz

Copia as imagens para o próprio site, monta o feed e o índice da busca, e escreve uma página por post, por categoria, por tag e por autor.

posts.title: Sample: how this blog is built
posts.excerpt: Sample post. A post is written in the studio and becomes a static page of this site.
posts.html:
Sample post, written to test the blog.

Where a post comes from

A post is written and reviewed in the studio. When it is published, the site is rebuilt and the post becomes a static page.

What the build does

It copies the pictures to the site itself, writes the feed and the search index, and writes one page per post, per category, per tag and per author.

posts.title: Sample: notes on writing a post
posts.excerpt: Sample post. Who the post is for, one idea per section, and what a post can hold: lists, quotes, code and pictures.
posts.html:
Sample post, written to test the blog.

Start with the reader

Say who the post is for and what it answers. Then answer it.

  • One idea per section.
  • Short sentences.
  • A heading that says what the section holds.
  1. Write the draft.
  2. Cut what repeats.
  3. Read it aloud.

What a post can hold

  • Lists, numbered or not.
  • Quotes and inline code.

A quote sits apart from the text around it.

Headings

Two levels are enough. The contents beside the post list them.

posts.title: Sample: escaping test & "quotes" 'single' bold
posts.html:
Sample post, written to test the blog. Every plain-text field of this post carries characters that mean something to HTML, and none of them may become markup.

Escaping <script>alert("toc")</script> & 'quotes'

In the body the same characters arrive already escaped: <script>alert("body")</script> & "quotes".

Why it matters

A title is whatever its author typed. The page shows those characters; it never runs them.

posts.title: Exemplo: teste de escape & "aspas" 'simples' negrito
posts.excerpt: Conteúdo de exemplo. "> & não é marcação
posts.html:
Post de exemplo, escrito para testar o blog. Todo campo de texto puro deste post leva caracteres que significam algo para o HTML, e nenhum deles pode virar marcação.

Escapando <script>alert("sumário")</script> & 'aspas'

No corpo os mesmos caracteres chegam já escapados: <script>alert("corpo")</script> & "aspas".

Por que importa

Um título é o que o autor digitou. A página mostra esses caracteres; nunca os executa.

posts.title: Sample: how the search works
posts.excerpt: Sample post. The search covers the posts and loads only when you use it.
posts.html:
Sample post, written to test the blog.

What gets indexed

The posts, and only the posts. Lists, menus and the footer stay out.

When it loads

The search loads when you first use the field. Until then the page asks for nothing.

posts.title: Sample: a glossary of terms
posts.excerpt: Sample post. A short list of the words this blog uses about itself.
posts.html:
Sample post, written to test the blog.

  • Post: one page with a title and a body.
  • Category: one per post, at most.
  • Tag: free words, as many as the post needs.
  • Feed: the list of posts a reader can subscribe to.
